generationInputs.prompt: In a wide underwater shot, a male diver wearing a full metal diving helmet, a black dry suit, and flippers, swims from the left side of the frame towards a treasure chest on a rock formation on the right, his head facing the chest. His right hand holds a flashlight that emits a bright white beam, illuminating the immediate area in front of him and the chest. The chest is dark and metallic with golden latches and hinges, and a glowing orange microphone icon on its front. A small blue seahorse, positioned above the chest, glows faintly. The underwater scene is filled with subtle air bubbles rising, and a dark blue background with sunlight filtering from above, creating a serene and mysterious atmosphere. The "NAUTILUS" text, originally at the top of the frame, slowly dissolves and disappears from the scene as the diver approaches the chest.
